// Temporary (#304): prints this host's Windows exception-context size.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"
)

func main() {
	k := syscall.NewLazyDLL("kernel32.dll")
	initCtx := k.NewProc("InitializeContext")
	features := k.NewProc("GetEnabledXStateFeatures")
	const contextAll, contextXState = 0x0010001f, 0x00100040
	var length uint32
	_, _, err := initCtx.Call(0, contextAll|contextXState, 0, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&length)))
	f, _, _ := features.Call()
	fmt.Printf("HOST InitializeContext(CONTEXT_ALL|CONTEXT_XSTATE) = %d bytes (%v), xstate features = %#x\n", length, err, f)
}
